name: Edgar Allan Poe Speakeasy
description: Four Edgar Allan Poe stories are performed live, each paired with a themed cocktail, at Hot Five Jazz&Blues Club on 7 November at 15:00 and 17:30. Tickets from €27.
longDescription:
The Edgar Allan Poe Speakeasy is a 90-minute evening of theatre and cocktails. Performers called Poe Historians present four of Poe's stories on stage in a gothic setting.

Each story comes with its own signature cocktail: The Tell-Tale Heart with the Pale Blue Eye, The Black Cat with The Cat's Meow, The Raven with Nevermore, and The Masque of the Red Death with the Cocktail of the Red Death. You can ask for mocktails at the venue.

The event is at Hot Five Jazz&Blues Club, Rua de Guerra Junqueiro 495, on Saturday 7 November 2026, with sessions at 15:00 and 17:30. Seats are given out on arrival, first come first served. Tickets from €27.

longDescriptionPt:
O Edgar Allan Poe Speakeasy é uma noite de 90 minutos de teatro e cocktails. Artistas chamados Historiadores de Poe apresentam quatro das histórias de Poe em palco, num cenário gótico.

Cada história vem com o seu próprio cocktail de assinatura: The Tell-Tale Heart com o Pale Blue Eye, The Black Cat com The Cat's Meow, The Raven com Nevermore, e The Masque of the Red Death com o Cocktail of the Red Death. Pode pedir mocktails no local.

O evento realiza-se no Hot Five Jazz&Blues Club, Rua de Guerra Junqueiro 495, no sábado, 7 de novembro de 2026, com sessões às 15:00 e 17:30. Os lugares são atribuídos à chegada, por ordem de chegada. Bilhetes a partir de 27€.
